name: subkit
description: A self-hostable, multi-tenant engine for governed, versioned, AI-assisted workflow execution against connected systems.
author: Mike Bild

scripts.build:all: bun run build:engine && bun run build:sk
scripts.build:cockpit: NODE_ENV=production bunx vite build --config apps/cockpit/vite.config.ts && bun run gen:cockpit
scripts.build:engine: bun run build:clipper && bun run build:cockpit && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts --compile --external cpu-features --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/engine && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/engine
scripts.build:engine:linux-x64: bun run build:clipper && bun run build:cockpit && bun scripts/fetch-embedding-assets.ts && bun build apps/engine/src/index.ts --compile --external cpu-features --target=bun-linux-x64 --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"${ENGINE_VERSION:-$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')}\"" --outfile dist/engine-linux-x64
scripts.build:sk: bun run build:clipper && bun build apps/sk/src/index.ts --compile --external cpu-features --define "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV" --define "BUILD_VERSION=\"$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')\"" --outfile dist/sk && sh scripts/codesign-macos.sh dist/sk
scripts.check:cockpit-drift: bun run build:cockpit && git diff --exit-code assets/cockpit apps/engine/src/http/cockpit-embedded.ts
scripts.check:config-example-drift: bun run gen:config-example && git diff --exit-code subkit.config.example.json
scripts.check:embedded-drift: bun run db:gen-embedded && git diff --exit-code apps/engine/src/db/migrations/embedded.ts
scripts.check:llms-txt-drift: bun run gen:llms-txt && git diff --exit-code apps/engine/src/http/llms
scripts.check:openapi-drift: bun run gen:openapi-client && git diff --exit-code packages/cli-core/src/engine-api apps/cockpit/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && sh scripts/ensure-env.sh && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate && bun run scripts/normalize-migration-schema.ts && bun run db:gen-embedded
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:sk && bun run scripts/test-e2e-isolated.ts
scripts.test:flake: for s in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "--- seed=$s ---"; SUBKIT_DETERMINISTIC_SEED=$s bun run test:unit || exit 1; done
scripts.test:integration: bun run scripts/test-files-isolated.ts apps/engine/src/db apps/engine/src/queue apps/engine/src/http apps/engine/src/webhooks apps/engine/src/credentials/oauth2 apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/server-provider.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/mcp-oauth-discovery.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/mcp-oauth-flow.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/mcp-oauth-scope-audit.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/oauth/mcp-oauth-withdrawal.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/providers/mcp-oauth.test.ts apps/engine/src/auth/providers/tests/oidc-safe-redirect.test.ts apps/engine/src/scheduler/tests/mcp-oauth-cleanup.test.ts apps/engine/src/scheduler/tests/oauth2-keepalive.test.ts apps/engine/src/skills/tests/seed.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/recipe-flow.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/destructive-banner.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/skill-autoload-tenant.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/conversations/tools/tests/load-skill-audit.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/preflight/tests/vault-ops.integration.test.ts apps/engine/src/tests/self-update.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/registry.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/oauth-provider.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/client/pool-needs-auth.test.ts apps/engine/src/operator/health-digest-risk.int.test.ts apps/engine/src/mcp/tests
